notes: Run 2026-10-26. LinkedIn/Instagram not opened (no login-free text expected); Chrome used for 6 page loads only.

EngageSC /<slug>/web_officers via curl is the most reliable club source: returns officer name, role and Student/Faculty tag with no JS. It states no term, so term=null. Works for troylabs, lavalab, spark, ProductSc, hacksc, TrojanVenturePartners; not for EVMA (slug has no officers listed).

Club own sites: usclavalab.org and troylabs.vc list exec boards and agree with EngageSC (troylabs.vc also shows Charlotte Chang as President, EngageSC lists her Vice President; EngageSC used, co-president possible). sparksc.org/our-people is stale (Core F'24-S'25), EngageSC used for Spark.
viterbiinnovation.usc.edu (TIE Hub) blocks curl via Cloudflare; works in Chrome but has no team page; /contact/ shows only a generic mailbox. 4 TIE Hub programs unresolved.
marshall.usc.edu Greif Center page (curl) has a GREIF CENTER STAFF section with director titles. NVSC and USC Venture Capital use center director Dan Wadhwani (center-level, not program-specific).
stevens.usc.edu/directory/ works via curl and lists titles; Executive Director is a center-level contact. Techstars page names Telesha Bowen as Program Manager (undated).
keck.usc.edu/mesh/mesh-team/ needs Chrome (Cloudflare on curl) but lists titles clearly. uscventurecapital.com is JS only: needs Chrome; /about lists faculty and staff without a fund lead.
ami.usc.edu returns empty; AMI name comes from a Sept 2025 research.usc.edu announcement (may be dated).
